words.definitionZh: 執行市場調查；進行市場研究

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: All project leaders are required to submit their weekly progress summaries carry out market studies before Friday's executive meeting.

examples.en: All project leaders are required to submit their weekly progress summaries go together before Friday's executive meeting.

examples.zh: 我司【私下地】擴展了全球經銷網絡，以滿足日益增長的國際消費者需求。
